description: A summary of the features described in reviews and related content for the Windows version includes: Six new characters to style. New tools: razor, curling iron, crimper, and a straightener. Ability to cut, color, comb, shave, and blow-dry hair. A special tonic called G.R.O.W. to make hair grow back. Accessories like hats, glasses, and bow ties were available. A camera booth to take snapshots of the finished hairstyles. No in-app purchases.
